04068 Madown {maw-dohn'}

與 04067 同; 專有名詞 地名

AV - Madon 2; 2

瑪頓 = "爭吵"
1) 迦南的主要城巿之一,聯合耶賓王及其他同盟者對抗約書亞
   在米倫水邊的戰役被打敗

04068 Madown {maw-dohn'}

the same as 04067;; n pr loc

AV - Madon 2; 2

Madon = "strife"
1) one of the principal cities of Canaan who joined Jabin and his
   confederates in their battle against Joshua at the waters of Merom
   and were defeated
